_comment: SHA-256 of the game files this port was developed and tested against (Six Guns 2.9.9a, Android, arm64). build_sd.py compares a player's files with these and reports differences; the game files themselves are never distributed with the port.

apk._comment: Official Gameloft-signed APK of 2.9.9a (version code 29923; signer O=Gameloft, cert SHA-256 2173A248...481C; v1 signature verified, all 948 entries intact). Its lib/arm64-v8a/libAndroid.so is identical to the tested engine. A re-signed copy with the same engine (tested during development) is listed too.

_known_modified._comment: Repackaged APKs seen in the wild whose engine differs from Gameloft's (do not use): the APKVISION re-pack (package renamed .apkvision, re-signed) has libAndroid.so cc1b202806120653.... Its libgenerator.so is identical to the official one (libgenerator.so is part of Gameloft's signed APK).
